body:
My experience on Avicus has been up and down over the 5 years I've played. It was good fun and I enjoyed meeting all the nice people I did. 

People who had an impact on me:

{tag=7645ddf4092041aaa5a53c583238cdb6}

You will probably never see this. But you were a true homie. Always had my back and made me laugh. We had good times leading Qrysis but kind of stopped talking after we disbanded.

{tag=bee1fadc3ff844c99258e08d3fa03fff} {tag=5ecdf615b1424cd797fb4ede125da843}

You're probably my bestfriends here, you're very chill and nice to talk to. You can be assholes alot but it's just for fun. I know we will still talk after this but just want you to know i love you. No homo
